searchText: <Benewagner> Hey all 🙂 happy to share a new work with @khovratovich, Gotti, Mike, and Stefano: https://eprint.iacr.org/2026/016.pdf TLDR: we have developed a new cryptographic framework, which allows as to more easily build and analyze new proving-friendly encodings for leanSig. Two are already presented in the paper 🙂 another nice application of the framework is a new abstraction for grinding in Fiat-Shamir 🙂 <Mathijs_nd> Anyone know of any projects that are raising? Series A series B seed round. Hit me up Looking for a new opportunity to dive in. <TomasGruner> Hello guys! Here's an update on current ethlambda client status: lean-quickstart integration is currently working, the client already connects to devnet peers and receives new blocks, exposing the latest slot in metrics (as specced in leanMetrics repo). Next step is implementing the state transition function. I'm planning to send weekly updates here, with more frequent updates in https://t.me/ethlambda_client, but let me know if there's a better channel for these.

<TomasGruner> Hello guys! Here's an update on current ethlambda client status:

lean-quickstart integration is currently working, the client already connects to devnet peers and receives new blocks, exposing the latest slot in metrics (as specced in leanMetrics repo).
Next step is implementing the state transition function.

I'm planning to send weekly updates here, with more frequent updates in https://t.me/ethlambda_client, but let me know if there's a better channel for these.
